content: Enzi zifîre zinashereze enjebe y’amavurha g’amalâshi, isirhe lisungunu linakole kulusha oburhimanya n’olukengwa.
Omurhimanya bwinjà ahêka, n’omusirhe agende oluhengu.
Omusirhe ajè omu mulimbwa kwône: abule irhwe anayêreke abandi oku ali musirhe.
E erhi mwâmi akakuhêkakwo oburhè, orhahinyagya, bulyâla okurhûza kunarhume omuntu arhalogorha.
Hali obubî mbwîne hano nshi kulinziribà nka kuhaba kw’omukulu:
isirhe libè lyo bayîmika, n’abagale bakeresibwe halya hababonêsa nshonyi.
Ndwîrhe nabona abajà bagenda oku nfarasi n’abarhwâli bagende n’amagulu nka bajà.
Ohumba omwîna anagugwemwo, n’ohumba olukûta, enjoka enamulume.
Olengeza amabuye, ganamuyagaze, obeza enshâli naye hali amango acîyagaza.
Embasha ekatûha, kubula carhyâza kurhuma, omuntu anayibande n’emisî; ci kwône obunguke bw’oburhimanya, kuli kuhasha.
Enjoka erhi yankaluma omuntu, kubula cashungurhira kurhuma, burhali bunguke bwa mushâke.
Akanwa k’abarhimanya binjà kaderha, akanwa k’omusirhe yêhe ko kanamuheza.
Obugula n’isirhe
Emyanzi yâge ayirhangira ya bihalârhi, ayishwinje likola isirhe.
Omusirhe ye luza emyanzi: omuntu arhishi ebyâbà; mbwîraga ndi wankamubwîriza ebyayishibà enyuma zâge?
Omukolo gw’abasirhe gunabashologorhe, orhamanyiri njira arhankajà omu lugo.
Wamâhera we cihugo mwâmi ali murhumba, n’abarhambo balegerere ha lya kurhenga sêzi.
Iragi ly’ecihugo omwâmi aburhwa muluzi, n’abarhambo balye amango gakwânîne, kuderha mpu babone emisî, ci arhali mpu banywe.
Okubà ntabiruba kunarhume omutungo gwahonongoka n’okubula cakombêra kunarhume enyumpa yaloba.
Ci kwône mpu ntâye bahanzize okusheka nk’ali oku cîbo! mpu amamvu ye mushagalusa! mpu n’ogwêrhe igerha erhi ntâco arhagwêrhi!
Orhahîra okasigira mwâmi enfûlago, ciru akabà omu nkengêro orhahîra, orhahehêreraga omugale, ciru akabà omu lwâwe oli, bulyâla akanyunyi kanahêke emyanzi, n’okubà omwanzi gujira ebyûbi.
